what: On a white curtain, three small vertical photos in the center row — they turn on after .3s at a .2s tempo in the order center, left, right, and switch to different photos twice in the same order and tempo. After a .5s rest, the sides blur out over .3s and the center one expands to fill the screen in 1s expo.inOut, then .5s later the whole curtain lifts away in 1.5s power4.out. If the last center photo is the same as the Hero photo, the intro simply becomes the Hero.

options.start: Delay before the first photo turns on (sec), default .3
options.grow: Length in seconds for the center to open, default 1 — it makes people wait, so shorten it in apps
options.wait: Delay after unfolding before the curtain lifts (s), default .5
options.when: If external, skipped when arriving via a link within the same site (knot) — default is always
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Photo row (child) — this spreads to fill the screen
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo slot (three) — data-key="main" The one that expands is the center column (or the middle one in order if none)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Stacked sheets inside a cell — the first sheet shows on load, then the next sheet each tempo
options.--fx-h: Photo row height (via style), default 39.26% (phone --fx-h-narrow 19%, min 164px)
options.--fx-gap: Gap between cells (via style), default 10px (5px on phones)
options.on: With load, starts on window load (after images are fully loaded) — as in the Brand original. Default is right on attach (the cover is covering from the start)
